VDM Packed  boys and went to pay homage to the king. They tried to beg and convince the king to change his mind and allow the commissioning to go on so that people who had already traveled would not waste their trip. The king still refused.

Let us be honest.

A village that has never had a beautiful school like this in its history should be celebrating. They should be shouting, dancing, and thanking the people who came to help them. Instead, it became about protocol, and even after VDM and the Ratels went to beg, the answer was still no. The children who are supposed to start using the place are still waiting.

You don't do celebration on weekends but you do campaign on weekends.

This is not good at all. We complain every day that the government does nothing, then when private people come and do something, we still find a way to slow it down. Some of us are truly our own enemies. Ego and tradition have become bigger than the future of those children.

The school will still be commissioned. But this situation shows that even when something good reaches our doorstep, some people will still look for reasons why it cannot happen.
